messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: "Translation" in HTML commands
parts:
Probably the easiest way is to just execute those functions at an R console, wrapped in cat(as.character(...)). For example:


> cat(as.character(shiny::fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File',
+           accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain'))))
<label>Choose CSV File</label>
<input id="file1" type="file" accept="text/csv,text/comma-separated-values,text/plain"/>

If you simply copy that resulting HTML and paste it into your own HTML document it should work identically.
